title: After the launcher's worker is lost (e.g. a host restart), recovery settles the run as interrupted while its stage children keep running and writing the run directory
outcome: A run that recovery settles as interrupted has no live stage processes left writing into its run directory, or the settlement says plainly that they are still alive.
acceptance: When a launcher worker disappears while a stage child (cargo or a test binary) is still alive, `recover` either shows that the stage's process group is gone before it writes the interrupted result, or records in that result that live stage processes remain, with their pids.
A test that observes behaviour covers a run whose worker is killed while its stage child keeps running. The test checks what recovery reports, and that nothing changes the settled result.
